Firing: hinge kept in one breath — impurity melts AND regard is withheld; wretched exact (dInA, abject); question unanswered (no consolation smuggled). REJECTED OPTIONS (with killers): (a) wretched->poor -> killed: poor is economic; wretched is abject. (b) regard->look on -> killed: regard regards (samavekSase: consider). (c) splitting question from context -> killed: hinge needs both halves. Read aloud: THE-riv-ers' WA-ter MELTS im-PUR-i-ty — … WHY do YOU re-GARD-me-NOT, WRETCH-ed AS-i-AM. Abhinavagupta frame: śṛṅgāra performed, not described — separated voice + landscape-answer are vibhāva; the cloud never told to carry a message is dhvani (suggestion doing the work); close in sustaining memory, not despair.

reads_against.argmap: Why unregarded? → Impurity melts outward; regard withheld.
c1_essence: Śṛṅgāra is performed, not described: the separated beloved's voice, her appeal to the cloud, and the landscape's answering her are all determinants (vibhāva) of the rasa. The cloud is never told to carry a message — that is dhvani, and it is what makes it the genre's first instance. The voice closes not in despair but in sustaining memory: the sthāyibhāva (love) transforms the sorrow (vyabhicāri) into something relishable. Kāma arises in the heart to kill; the beloved who is absent arises with him; the cātaka, thirsty for rain alone, begs water; the peacock-flock sounds at the clouds; she is protected only by remembrance of his virtue.
